description: Call one tool on a connected server listed by anyforge_list_connected_tools. A read tool runs now and returns its result. A write tool (`access: "write"`), or any tool marked `needsApproval`, does NOT run: AnyForge records the exact arguments and asks a person to approve it on the Approvals page or in Slack, then runs it. You get `status: "pending_approval"` and a `callId`; tell the user, do not call it again, and check the outcome later with anyforge_get_connected_tool_call. Never put a credential in `arguments`.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, as its input schema describes them.

name: anyforge_call_connected_tool
title: Call connected tool
